operations.description: This API is used to apply a central network policy.
This API is used to bind a bandwidth package to a cloud connection.
This API is used to bind a global connection bandwidth to an instance.
This API is used to bind a global connection bandwidth to a site-to-site connection.
This API is used to create or delete tags in batches.
This API is used to add tags to a global connection bandwidth.
This API is used to delete tags from a global connection bandwidth.
This API is used to query the number of global connection bandwidth tags in an account.
This API is used to grant another account permissions to load your network instances to their cloud connection.
This API is used to create a bandwidth package.
This API is used to add a central network policy. A policy cannot be modified. If the policy cannot meet your requirements, you need to add a new policy.
This API is used to create a cloud connection.
This API is used to add a tag to a global connection bandwidth.
This API is used to create a global connection bandwidth.
This API is used to assign an inter-region bandwidth.
This API is used to create a network instance.
This API is used to create a P2P site network.
This API is used to add a tag to a resource.
This API is used to cancel the authorization that allows other users to load your network instances to their cloud connection.
This API is used to delete a bandwidth package.
This API is used to delete a central network. Remove the attachments before deleting the central network.
This API is used to remove an attachment from a central network.
This API is used to delete a central network policy. An applied policy cannot be deleted.
This API is used to delete a cloud connection.
This API is used to delete a tag from a global connection bandwidth.
This API is used to delete a global connection bandwidth.
This API is used to delete an inter-region bandwidth.
This API is used to remove a network instance.
This API is used to delete a site network.
This API is used to delete a resource tag.
This API is used to unbind a bandwidth package from a cloud connection.
This API is used to unbind a global connection bandwidth from an instance.
This API is used to unbind global connection bandwidth from a site-to-site connection.
This API is used to query the specifications of bandwidth packages for communications across geographic regions.
This API is used to query the supported geographic regions.

This API is used to query the list of authorizations that allow another account to use your network instances. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the bandwidth class list.
This API is used to query the bandwidth line list.
This API is used to query the bandwidth site list.
This API is used to query the tags of a bandwidth package.
This API is used to query the bandwidth package list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
Querying Bandwidth Packages by Tag

This API is used to query the list of central network attachments. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The default value of **limit** is **0**. If **marker** is not specified, the first data record is returned.
This API is used to query central network capabilities.

This API is used to query the list of central network connections. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The default value of **limit** is **0**. If **marker** is not specified, the first data record is returned.

This API is used to query the list of enterprise router route tables as attachments on a central network. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The default value of **limit** is **0**. If **marker** is not specified, the first data record is returned.

This API is used to query the list of global DC gateways on a central network. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The default value of **limit** is **0**. If **marker** is not specified, the first data record is returned.

This API is used to query the list of central network policies. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The default value of **limit** is **0**. If **marker** is not specified, the first data record is returned.
This API is used query the changes between the current policy and an applied policy.
This API is used to query the resource quotas.
This API is used to query the tags added to a central network.

This API is used to query the central network list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The default value of **limit** is **0**. If **marker** is not specified, the first data record is returned.
This API is used to query central networks by tag.
This API is used to query Cloud Connect capabilities.
This API is used to query cloud connection resource quotas.
This API is used to query the list of cloud connection routes. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the tags added to a cloud connection.
This API is used to query the cloud connection list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query cloud connections by tag.
This API is used to query all the tags by resource type.
This API is used to query the list of global connection bandwidths in an account.
This API is used to query a global connection bandwidth tag in an account.
This API is used to query all global connection bandwidth tags in an account.
This API is used to query the tenant configuration of a global connection bandwidth.
This API is used to query the line grade list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the site list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.

This API is used to query the line specification list. Fields in the response body of this API are controlled using a whitelist. They are left blank by default. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the global connection bandwidth list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the inter-region bandwidth list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the network instance list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.

This API is used to query the list of permissions to use network instances in another account. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the specifications of bandwidth packages for communications across regions.
This API is used to query supported regions.
This API is used to query resources by resource type.
This API is used to query the list of site network capabilities.
This API is used to query site network quotas.

This API is used to query the site network list. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The default value of **limit** is **0**. If **marker** is not specified, the first data record is returned.

This API is used to query the list of global connection bandwidths that meet the binding conditions. Parameters **marker** and **limit** are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
